items.title: Vanishing of the Bockstein beta versus lifting kernels modulo f in terms of f^2

items.difficulty_reason: 9 行、Bockstein β 的零化与模 f 核的提升：β 即短正合列 0 -> fM/f²M -> M/f²M -> M/fM -> 0 的上同调边缘映射，其长正合列把「Ker(d^i mod f) 能提升到 Ker(d^i mod f²)」与 β=0 等价起来；β≠0 时由 Bockstein 的因子分解式（0GSP）在 H^{i+1}(M) 中产生非零 f-挠，故 H^{i+1}(M)[f]=0 蕴含两等价条件。承重全在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-vanishing-beta (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 27782-27794

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the identification of beta as the connecting cohomology map of the short exact sequence of complexes 0 -> fM/f^2M -> M/f^2M -> M/fM -> 0, which yields the equivalence of the kernel-lifting condition with the vanishing of beta, and the forcing of a nonzero beta to produce f-torsion in H^{i+1} via the factorization identity (source lines 27796-27804)
